G5207.strongs: a "son" (sometimes of animals), used very widely of immediate, remote or figuratively, kinship
senses: a son;

in the ordinary sense: [[r:MAT.10.37|Mat 10:37]], [[r:MRK.9.17|Mrk 9:17]], [[r:LUK.1.13|Luk 1:13]], al. mult.; omitted with the art. of origin (WM, §30, 3; Bl., §35, 2), τὸν τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, [[r:ACT.13.22|Act 13:22]] (LXX); also with genitive anarth. (cl.), Σώπατρος Πύρρου Βεροιαῖος, [[r:ACT.20.4|Act 20:4]]; with adj., προτότοκος, [[r:LUK.2.7|Luk 2:7]]; μονογένης, [[r:LUK.7.12|Luk 7:12]]; opposite to νόθος, [[r:HEB.12.8|Heb 12:8]]; in a wider sense, of posterity: ὁ υἱ. Δαυΐδ, of the Messiah (cf. Dalman, Words, 316ff.; DCG, ii, 653f.), [[r:MAT.22.42|Mat 22:42, 45]] [[r:MRK.12.35|Mrk 12:35, 37]] [[r:LUK.20.41|Luk 20:41, 44]] al.; υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ, (cf. υἷες Ἀχαιῶν, Hom., Il., i, 162, al.), [[r:MAT.27.9|Mat 27:9]], [[r:ACT.9.15|Act 9:15]], al.
Metaphorical;

as belonging to, being connected with or having the quality of that which follows (a usage mainly due to translation from a Semitic original; cf. Deiss., BS, 161ff.; Dalman, Words, 115f.; DCG, ii, 652f.): τ. πονεροῦ (διαβόλου), [[r:MAT.13.38|Mat 13:38]], [[r:ACT.13.10|Act 13:10]]; τ. νυμφῶνος (see: νυμφών), [[r:MAT.9.15|Mat 9:15]], [[r:MRK.2.19|Mrk 2:19]], al.; τ. φωτός (Lft., Notes, 74), [[r:LUK.16.8|Luk 16:8]], [[r:JHN.12.36|Jhn 12:36]], [[r:1TH.5.5|1Th 5:5]]; τ. εἰρεήμης, [[r:LUK.10.6|Luk 10:6]]; γεέννης, [[r:MAT.23.15|Mat 23:15]]; τ. ἀπωλείας, [[r:JHN.17.12|Jhn 17:12]], [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3]]; τ. αἰῶνος τούτου, [[r:LUK.16.8|Luk 16:8 20:34]]; τ. ἀπειθειάς, [[r:EPH.2.2|Eph 2:2 5:6]]; βροντῆς, [[r:MRK.3.17|Mrk 3:17]]; τ. ἀναστάσεως, [[r:LUK.20.36|Luk 20:36]]; παρακλήσεως, [[r:ACT.4.36|Act 4:36]]; τ. προφητῶν κ. τ. διαθήκης, [[r:ACT.3.25|Act 3:25]];

υἱὸς τ. θεοῦ (cf. Dalman, Words, 268ff.; Deiss., BS, 166f.; DB, iv, 570 ff.; DCG, ii, 654ff.), of men, as partakers of the Divine nature and of the life to come: [[r:MAT.5.9|Mat 5:9]], [[r:LUK.20.36|Luk 20:36]], [[r:ROM.8.14|Rom 8:14 9:26]], al.; υἱοὶ (κ. θυγατέρες) τ. ὑψίστου, [[r:LUK.6.35|Luk 6:35]], [[r:2CO.6.18|2Co 6:18]]; in an unique sense of Jesus, [[r:MAT.4.3|Mat 4:3 8:29 28:19]], [[r:MRK.3.4|Mrk 3:4]], [[r:LUK.4.41|Luk 4:41]], [[r:JHN.9.35|Jhn 9:35 11:27]], al.; ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱ. τ. θεοῦ ζῶντος (τ. εὐλογητοῦ), [[r:MAT.16.16|Mat 16:16]], [[r:MRK.14.61|Mrk 14:61]]; (with) (ὁ) υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου (in LXX for Heb. בּן אדם, Aram, בּר אנשׁ; cf. Dalman, Words, 234ff.; DB, iv, 579ff.; DCG, ii, 659ff.; Westc., St. John, i, 74ff.; other reff. in Swete, Mk, 2:10), based on the Aram. of [[r:DAN.7.13|Dan 7:13]], where the phrase, like the corresponding Heb. (as in [[r:PSA.8.5|Psa 8:5]]), means a man, one of the species, and indicates the human appearance of the person in question. It is used of the Messiah in Enoch, with 46, §1-4, also in II [[r:EST.13.3|Est 13:3, 12]], al. Our Lord first makes the phrase a title, using the def. art. It seems to combine the ideas of his true humanity and representative character. Exc. in [[r:ACT.7.56|Act 7:56]] and (anarth.) [[r:REV.1.13|Rev 1:13]] [[r:REV.14.14|14:14]], it is used of Jesus only by himself: [[r:MAT.8.20|Mat 8:20]], [[r:MRK.2.10|Mrk 2:10]], [[r:LUK.5.24|Luk 5:24]], [[r:JHN.1.52|Jhn 1:52]], al. (AS)

G5259.forms: ὑπό (before smooth breathing ὑπ᾽, [[r:MAT.8.9|Mat 8:9]]b, [[r:LUK.7.8|Luk 7:8]]b; before rough breathing ὑφ᾽, [[r:ROM.3.9|Rom 3:9]]; on the neglect of elision in Mt, Lk, ll. witha, [[r:GAL.3.22|Gal 3:22]], see WH, App., 146; Tdf., Pr., iv)
G5259.strongs: under, i.e. (with the genitive case) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative case) of place (whither (underneath) or where (below) or time (when (at))
G5259.kjv: among, by, from, in, of, under, with
senses: prep. with genitive, dative (not in NT), accusative
I

C. genitive, primarily of place, under, hence, metaphorically, of the efficient cause, by: after passive verbs, with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.1.22|Mat 1:22]], [[r:MRK.1.5|Mrk 1:5]], [[r:LUK.2.18|Luk 2:18]], [[r:JHN.14.21|Jhn 14:21]], [[r:ACT.4.11|Act 4:11]], [[r:1CO.1.11|1Co 1:11]], [[r:HEB.3.4|Heb 3:4]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MAT.8.24|Mat 8:24]], [[r:LUK.7.24|Luk 7:24]], [[r:ROM.3.21|Rom 3:21]], al.; with neut. verbs and verbs with pass, meaning, [[r:MAT.17.12|Mat 17:12]], [[r:MRK.5.26|Mrk 5:26]], [[r:1CO.10.9|1Co 10:9, 10]] [[r:1TH.2.14|1Th 2:14]], al.
II
C. accusative, under;

of motion: [[r:MAT.5.15|Mat 5:15 8:8]], [[r:MRK.4.21|Mrk 4:21]], [[r:LUK.13.34|Luk 13:34]]; hence, metaphorically, of subjection, [[r:ROM.7.14|Rom 7:14]], [[r:1CO.15.27|1Co 15:27]], [[r:GAL.3.22|Gal 3:22]], [[r:1PE.5.6|1Pe 5:6]], al.

Of position: [[r:JHN.1.49|Jhn 1:49]], [[r:ACT.4.12|Act 4:12]], [[r:ROM.3.13|Rom 3:13]], [[r:1CO.10.1|1Co 10:1]], al.; hence, metaphorically, under, subject to, [[r:MAT.8.9|Mat 8:9]], [[r:ROM.3.9|Rom 3:9]], [[r:1CO.9.20|1Co 9:20]], [[r:GAL.4.5|Gal 4:5]], al.
Of time, about: [[r:ACT.5.21|Act 5:21.]]
III
In composition: under (ὑποδέω), hence, of subjection (ὑποτάσσω), compliance (ὑπακούω), secrecy (ὑποβάλλω), diminution (ὑποπνέω). (AS)

G5258.root: from an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to [[w:G5259]] through the idea of subsilience)

G5263.strongs: to exhibit under the eyes, i.e. (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish)
senses: ὑπο-δείκνυμι
to show secretly.

to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.6.47|Luk 6:47 12:5]], [[r:ACT.9.16|Act 9:16]]; id. with inf., [[r:MAT.3.7|Mat 3:7]], [[r:LUK.3.7|Luk 3:7]]; before, ὅτι, [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35.]]† (AS)

G5204.strongs: water (as if rainy) literally or figuratively
senses: ὕδωρ genitive, ὕδατος, τό, water: [[r:MAT.3.16|Mat 3:16]], [[r:MRK.1.10|Mrk 1:10]], [[r:LUK.7.44|Luk 7:44]], [[r:JHN.4.7|Jhn 4:7]], [[r:JAS.3.12|Jas 3:12]], [[r:REV.8.10|Rev 8:10]], al.; pl., [[r:MAT.14.28|Mat 14:28-29]], [[r:JHN.3.23|Jhn 3:23]], [[r:REV.1.15|Rev 1:15]], al.; βαπτίζειν (ἐν) ὕδατι, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], [[r:MRK.1.8|Mrk 1:8]], [[r:JHN.1.26|Jhn 1:26]], al.; τ. λυυτρὸν τοῦ ὕ., [[r:EPH.5.26|Eph 5:26]]; opposite to οἴνος, [[r:JHN.2.9|Jhn 2:9 4:46]]; αἷμα, [[r:JHN.19.34|Jhn 19:34]], [[r:HEB.9.19|Heb 9:19]], [[r:1JN.5.6|1Jn 5:6]] [[r:JHN.5.8|Jn 5:8]] [[r:MAT.17.15|Mat 17:15]] [[r:MRK.9.22|Mrk 9:22]]; πνεῦμα, [[r:JHN.1.26|Jhn 1:26, 31 1:33]]; πνεῦμα καὶ πῦρ, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]];ἐξ ὕ. κ. πνεύματος γεννηθῆναι, [[r:JHN.3.5|Jhn 3:5]]; metaphorically, of divine truth and grace (τ.) ὕ. (τ.) ζῶν, [[r:JHN.4.10|Jhn 4:10-11]] (cf. [[r:JHN.4.13|Jhn 4:13-15]]); τ. ὕ. τ. ζωῆς, of spiritual refresh­ment, [[r:REV.21.6|Rev 21:6 22:1, 17]] (AS)

G5266.strongs: something bound under the feet, i.e. a shoe or sandal
senses: (ὑποδέω), a sole bound under the foot, a sandal: [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11 10:10]], [[r:MRK.1.7|Mrk 1:7]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35]], [[r:JHN.1.27|Jhn 1:27]]; τ. ποδῶν, [[r:ACT.7.33|Act 7:33]] (LXX) [[r:ACT.13.25|Act 13:25.]]† SYN.: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

G5217.strongs: to lead (oneself) under, i.e. withdraw or retire (as if sinking out of sight), literally or figuratively
senses: ὑπ-άγω a word of the vulgar language, in Pres. and imperfect only (Bl., § 53, 1).
I
Trans.
to lead or bring under, subdue (Hom., Hdt., al.; Ex, l.with).
to lead on slowly (Hdt., Xen., al.).
II

Intrans., to go slowly away, withdraw oneself, depart (so less frequently in cl.; Thuc., Eur., al.): absol., [[r:MAT.8.32|Mat 8:32 13:44]], [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33]], [[r:LUK.8.42|Luk 8:42 17:14]], [[r:JHN.6.67|Jhn 6:67 8:2 11:44 14:5, 28 18:8]]; οἱ ἐρχόμενοι κ. οἱ ὑπάγοντες, [[r:MRK.6.31|Mrk 6:31]]; ὑπῆγον κ. ἐπίστευον, [[r:JHN.12.11|Jhn 12:11]]; ἵνα ὑπαγῆτε κ. καρπὸν ψέρητε, [[r:JHN.15.16|Jhn 15:16]]; opposite to ἔρχεσθαι, [[r:JHN.3.8|Jhn 3:8 8:14]]; imperat., ὕπαγε, [[r:MAT.4.10|Mat 4:10 8:13 20:14]], [[r:MRK.2.9|Mrk 2:9]] T, [[r:MRK.7.29|Mrk 7:29 10:52]]; εἰς εἰρήνην (ἐν εἰ.), [[r:MRK.5.34|Mrk 5:34]], [[r:JAS.2.16|Jas 2:16]]; id. prefixed to another imperat. (Bl., § 79, 4), [[r:MAT.5.34|Mat 5:34 8:4 18:15 19:21 21:28 27:65 28:10]], [[r:MRK.1.44|Mrk 1:44 10:21 16:7]], [[r:JHN.4.16|Jhn 4:16 9:7]], [[r:REV.10.8|Rev 10:8]]; with καί inserted, [[r:REV.16.1|Rev 16:1]]; euphemistically, of death, [[r:MAT.26.24|Mat 26:24]], [[r:MRK.14.21|Mrk 14:21]]; with adv.: ποῦ (which see), [[r:JHN.12.35|Jhn 12:35 14:5 16:5]], [[r:1JN.2.11|1Jn 2:11]]; ὅπου (which see), [[r:JHN.8.21|Jhn 8:21-22 13:33, 36 14:4]] [[r:REV.14.4|Rev 14:4]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:JHN.11.8|Jhn 11:8]]; with prep.: πρός, [[r:JHN.7.33|Jhn 7:33 13:3 16:5, 10 16:17]]; εἰς, [[r:MAT.9.6|Mat 9:6 20:4, 7]], [[r:MRK.2.11|Mrk 2:11 11:2 14:13]], [[r:LUK.19.30|Luk 19:30]], [[r:JHN.6.21|Jhn 6:21 7:3 9:11 11:31]], [[r:REV.13.10|Rev 13:10 17:8, 11]]; εἰς... πρός, [[r:MAT.26.18|Mat 26:18]], [[r:MRK.5.19|Mrk 5:19]]; ἐπί, [[r:LUK.12.58|Luk 12:58]]; μετά, [[r:MAT.5.41|Mat 5:41]]; ὀπίσω, [[r:MAT.16.23|Mat 16:23]], [[r:MRK.8.33|Mrk 8:33]]; with inf., [[r:JHN.21.3|Jhn 21:3.]]† (AS)

G5257.root: from [[w:G5259]] and a derivative of ἐρέσσω (to row)
G5257.strongs: an under-oarsman, i.e. (generally) subordinate (assistant, sexton, constable)
senses: (ὑπό + ἐρέτης, a rower) prop., an under rower; hence, generally, a servant, attendant, minister: of a magistrate's attendant, [[r:MAT.5.25|Mat 5:25]]; of officers of the Synagogue or Sanhedrin, [[r:MAT.26.58|Mat 26:58]], [[r:MRK.14.54|Mrk 14:54, 65]], [[r:LUK.4.20|Luk 4:20]], [[r:JHN.7.32|Jhn 7:32, 45-46 18:3, 12 18:22 19:6]], [[r:ACT.5.22|Act 5:22, 26]]; of the attendants of kings, οἱ ὑ. οἱ ἑμοί [[r:JHN.18.36|Jhn 18:36]]; of Christian ministers, [[r:ACT.13.5|Act 13:5 26:16]]; ὑπηρέται λόγου, [[r:LUK.1.2|Luk 1:2]]; Χριστοῦ, [[r:1CO.4.1|1Co 4:1]]; δοῦλοι κ. ὑ., [[r:JHN.18.18|Jhn 18:18.]]† SYN.: see: διάκονος (AS)

G5286.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G5259]] and [[w:G4228]]
G5286.strongs: something under the feet, i.e. a foot-rest (figuratively)
senses: (ὑπό, πούς), a footstool (= cl. θρᾶνος): [[r:JAS.2.3|Jas 2:3]]; metaphorically, [[r:MAT.5.35|Mat 5:35]], [[r:MRK.12.36|Mrk 12:36]] (ὑποκάτω, WH, R, mg.), [[r:LUK.20.43|Luk 20:43]], [[r:ACT.2.35|Act 2:35 7:49]], [[r:HEB.1.13|Heb 1:13 10:13]] (all, except Mt, l.with, from LXX, [[r:PSA.110.1|Psa 110:1]], [[r:ISA.66.1|Isa 66:1]]) (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 223).† (AS)

G5228.forms: ὑπέρ (when following subst.—poët.—ὕπερ; so as adv., [[r:2CO.11.23|2Co 11:23]])
G5228.strongs: "over", i.e. (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than
G5228.kjv: (+ exceeding, abundantly) above, in (on) behalf of, beyond, by, + very chiefest, concerning, exceeding (above, -ly), for, + very highly, more (than), of, over, on the part of, for sake of, in stead, than, to(-ward), very
senses: prep. with genitive, accusative
I
C. genitive, primarily of place (rest or motion), over, above, across, beyond, hence, metaphorically,

for, on behalf of: of prayer, [[r:MAT.5.44|Mat 5:44]], [[r:ACT.8.24|Act 8:24]], [[r:ROM.10.1|Rom 10:1]], [[r:JAS.5.16|Jas 5:16]], al.; of laying down life, [[r:JHN.10.11|Jhn 10:11]], [[r:ROM.9.3|Rom 9:3]], al.; esp. of Christ giving his life for man's redemption, [[r:MRK.14.24|Mrk 14:24]], [[r:JHN.10.15|Jhn 10:15]], [[r:ACT.21.13|Act 21:13]], [[r:ROM.5.6|Rom 5:6-8]], al.; opposite to κατά, [[r:MRK.9.40|Mrk 9:40]], [[r:LUK.9.50|Luk 9:50]], [[r:ROM.8.31|Rom 8:31]].

Causal, for, because of, for the sake of: with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.5.41|Act 5:41]], [[r:ROM.1.5|Rom 1:5]], [[r:PHP.1.29|Php 1:29]], [[r:2CO.12.10|2Co 12:10]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:JHN.11.4|Jhn 11:4]], [[r:ROM.15.8|Rom 15:8]], [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6]], al.
= ἀντί (see M, Pr., 105), for, instead of, in the name of: [[r:1CO.15.29|1Co 15:29]], [[r:2CO.5.15|2Co 5:15, 21]] [[r:GAL.3.13|Gal 3:13]], [[r:COL.1.7|Col 1:7]], Phm 13 (cf. Field, Notes, 225).
In more colourless sense, = περί (M, Pr., l.with), for, concerning, with regard to: [[r:ROM.9.27|Rom 9:27]], [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6 8:23 12:8]], [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7]], [[r:2TH.2.1|2Th 2:1]], al.
II

C. accusative, primarily of place, over, beyond, across, hence, metaphorically, of measure or degree in excess, above, beyond, over, more than: [[r:MAT.10.24|Mat 10:24, 37]] [[r:LUK.6.40|Luk 6:40]], [[r:ACT.26.13|Act 26:13]], [[r:1CO.10.13|1Co 10:13]], [[r:2CO.1.8|2Co 1:8]], [[r:EPH.1.22|Eph 1:22 3:20]], Phm 16, al.; after comparatives = than ([[r:JDG.11.25|Jdg 11:25]], al.), [[r:LUK.16.8|Luk 16:8]], [[r:HEB.4.12|Heb 4:12]].
III
As adv. (see supr. ad init.), more: ὕπερ ἐγώ, I more, [[r:2CO.11.23|2Co 11:23]]; in compounds, see: ὑπεράνω, ὑπερλίαν, ὑπερπερισσῶς.
IV
In composition: over (ὑπεραίρω), beyond (ὑπερβάλλω), more (ὐπερνικάω), on behalf of (ὐπερεντυγχάνω). (AS)

G5273.strongs: an actor under an assumed character (stage-player), i.e. (figuratively) a dissembler ("hypocrite"
senses: ὑπο-κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see)
one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.).

a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). Metaphorical (in LXX and NT), a pretender, dissembler, hypocrite: [[r:MAT.6.2|Mat 6:2, 5 6:16 7:5 15:7 22:18 23:13-15 24:51]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6]] [[r:LUK.6.42|Luk 6:42 12:56 13:15]].† (AS)

senses: ὑπακούω to listen, attend, hence,
to answer a knock at a door (Plat., Xen., al.): [[r:ACT.12.13|Act 12:13]];

to attend to, submit to, obey (Hdt., Thuc., al.): absol., [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]]; with inf., [[r:HEB.11.8|Heb 11:8]]; with dative of person(s) (Plat., al.; but more frequently with genitive), [[r:MAT.8.27|Mat 8:27]], [[r:MRK.1.27|Mrk 1:27 4:41]], [[r:LUK.8.25|Luk 8:25 17:6]], [[r:ROM.6.16|Rom 6:16]], [[r:EPH.6.1|Eph 6:1]], 5, [[r:COL.3.20|Col 3:20, 22]], [[r:HEB.5.9|Heb 5:9]], [[r:1PE.3.6|1Pe 3:6]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.6.7|Act 6:7]], [[r:ROM.6.12|Rom 6:12 10:16]], [[r:2TH.1.8|2Th 1:8 3:14]]; before εἰς (by attraction, for dative; see ICC, in l), [[r:ROM.6.17|Rom 6:17.]]† (AS)

G5221.strongs: to go opposite (meet) under (quietly), i.e. to encounter, fall in with

G5222.strongs: an encounter or concurrence (with for infinitive, in order to fall in with)

G5278.strongs: to stay under (behind), i.e. remain; figuratively, to undergo, i.e. bear (trials), have fortitude, persevere
G5278.kjv: abide, endure, (take) patient(-ly), suffer, tarry behind
senses: ὑπο-μένω
in-trans., to stay behind: before ἐν, [[r:LUK.2.43|Luk 2:43]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:ACT.17.14|Act 17:14.]]
Trans.,
with accusative, to await, wait for: [[r:ROM.8.24|Rom 8:24]] (Hom., Hdt., Xen., al.);

of things, to bear patiently, endure: absol., [[r:MAT.10.22|Mat 10:22 24:13]], [[r:MRK.13.13|Mrk 13:13]], [[r:2TI.2.12|2Ti 2:12]], [[r:JAS.5.11|Jas 5:11]], [[r:1PE.2.20|1Pe 2:20]]; τ. θλίψει (dative of circumstance), [[r:ROM.12.12|Rom 12:12]]; before εἰς, [[r:HEB.12.7|Heb 12:7]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.13.7|1Co 13:7]], [[r:2TI.2.10|2Ti 2:10]], [[r:HEB.10.32|Heb 10:32 12:2-3]], [[r:JAS.1.12|Jas 1:12]].† SYN.: μακροθυμέω (see: ὑπομονή) (AS)

G5225.strongs: to begin under (quietly), i.e. come into existence (be present or at hand); expletively, to exist (as copula or subordinate to an adjective, participle, adverb or preposition, or as an auxiliary to a principal (verb)
senses: ὑπάρχω
to begin, make a beginning (Hom., Hdt., al.).
to be in existence, be ready, be at hand (Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[r:ACT.19.40|Act 19:40 27:12, 21]]; before ἐν, [[r:ACT.28.18|Act 28:18.]]

to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition (cf. Gifford, Incarnation, 11 ff.; MM, xxv): with, nom, pred., [[r:LUK.8.41|Luk 8:41 9:48]], [[r:ACT.4.34|Act 4:34 7:55 8:16 16:3 19:36 21:20]], [[r:1CO.7.26|1Co 7:26 12:22]], [[r:JAS.2.15|Jas 2:15]], [[r:2PE.3.11|2Pe 3:11]]; ptcp. with pred., [[r:LUK.16.14|Luk 16:14 23:50]], [[r:ACT.2.30|Act 2:30, 32 17:24 22:3]], [[r:ROM.4.19|Rom 4:19]], [[r:1CO.2.15|1Co 2:15]], [[r:2CO.8.17|2Co 8:17 12:16]], [[r:GAL.1.14|Gal 1:14 2:14]]; pl., [[r:LUK.11.13|Luk 11:13]], [[r:ACT.16.20|Act 16:20, 37 17:29]], [[r:2PE.2.19|2Pe 2:19]]; before ἐν, with dative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.7.25|Luk 7:25 16:23]], [[r:ACT.5.4|Act 5:4 10:12]], [[r:1CO.11.18|1Co 11:18]], [[r:PHP.3.20|Php 3:20]]; ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων (R, mg., being originally), [[r:PHP.2.6|Php 2:6]]; ἐν, with dative of person(s), (among), [[r:1CO.11.18|1Co 11:18]]; μακρὰν ἀπό, [[r:ACT.17.27|Act 17:27]]; πρὸς τ. σωτηρίας, [[r:ACT.27.34|Act 27:34.]]

to belong to (Thuc., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.3.6|Act 3:6 4:37 28:7]], [[r:2PE.1.8|2Pe 1:8]]; τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, one's belongings, possessions: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.8.3|Luk 8:3 12:15]], [[r:ACT.4.32|Act 4:32]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.19.21|Mat 19:21 24:47 25:14]], [[r:LUK.11.21|Luk 11:21 12:33, 44 14:33 16:1 19:8]], [[r:1CO.13.3|1Co 13:3]], [[r:HEB.10.34|Heb 10:34]] (cf. προ-υπάρχω).† (AS)

G5268.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G5259]] and [[w:G2218]]
G5268.strongs: an animal under the yoke (draught-beast), i.e. (specially), a donkey
senses: ὑπο-ζύγιος, -α, -ον under the yoke; as subst., τ. (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: [[r:MAT.21.5|Mat 21:5]] (LXX), [[r:2PE.2.16|2Pe 2:16.]]† (AS)

ύπο-κάτω comp. adv. (see M, Pr., 99), below, under: as prep. with genitive, [[r:MAT.22.44|Mat 22:44]], [[r:MRK.6.11|Mrk 6:11 7:28 12:36]] (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), [[r:LUK.8.16|Luk 8:16]], [[r:JHN.1.51|Jhn 1:51]], [[r:HEB.2.8|Heb 2:8]]" (LXX), [[r:REV.5.3|Rev 5:3, 13 6:9 12:1]].† (AS)

G5272.strongs: acting under a feigned part, i.e. (figuratively) deceit ("hypocrisy")
senses: ὑπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see)
a reply, answer (Hdt.).

play-acting (Arist., Polyb., al.). Metaphorical, pretence, hypocrisy: [[r:MAT.23.28|Mat 23:28]], [[r:MRK.12.15|Mrk 12:15]], [[r:LUK.12.1|Luk 12:1]], [[r:GAL.2.13|Gal 2:13]], [[r:1TI.4.2|1Ti 4:2]], [[r:1PE.2.1|1Pe 2:1]] (Polyb., Pss [[r:SNG.4.7|Sng 4:7]]).† (AS)

G5214.strongs: to hymn, i.e. sing a religious ode; by implication, to celebrate (God) in song
senses: (ὕμνος)
trans., with accusative of person(s) (in cl. also with accusative of thing(s)), to sing to, laud, sing to the praise of: [[r:ACT.16.25|Act 16:25]], [[r:HEB.2.12|Heb 2:12]].
Intrans., to sing: in LXX and NT, of singing hymns and praises to God ([[r:PSA.65.13|Psa 65:13]], al.), [[r:MAT.26.30|Mat 26:30]], [[r:MRK.14.26|Mrk 14:26]] (see Swete, in l).† (AS)

G5265.strongs: to bind under one's feet, i.e. put on shoes or sandals
senses: ὑπο-δέω to blind under, esp. of foot gear. Most frequently in mid, and pass. with accusative;
of the foot, ὑποδησάμενοι τ. πόδας, your feet shod: [[r:EPH.6.15|Eph 6:15]];
of that which is put on, σανδάλια: [[r:MRK.6.9|Mrk 6:9]], [[r:ACT.12.8|Act 12:8]].† (AS)
(ὑπερήφανος, which see), haughtiness, arrogance, disdain: [[r:MRK.7.22|Mrk 7:22]] (Plat., Xen.).† (AS)
ὑπερ-περισσῶς adv., beyond measure, exceedingly: [[r:MRK.7.37|Mrk 7:37.]]† (AS)

G5276.root: neuter of a presumed compound of [[w:G5259]] and [[w:G3025]]
G5276.strongs: vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat
senses: (ὑπό, ληνός), a vessel or trough beneath a winepress to receive the juice (RV, a pit for the winepress): [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]] (see Swete, in l, and cf. ληνός).† (AS)
(ὑπέρ, φαίνομαι, with η pleonast., see Kühner3, I, 189) showing oneself above others;
in good sense (Plat., al.), pre-eminent, splendid;

more frequently in had sense, and so always in Scr., arrogant, haughty, disdainful (see Westc. Epp. Jo., 65b): [[r:ROM.1.30|Rom 1:30]], [[r:2TI.3.2|2Ti 3:2]]; διανοίᾳ καρδίας, [[r:LUK.1.51|Luk 1:51]]; opposite to ταπεινός (as in [[r:PRO.3.34|Pro 3:34]]), [[r:JAS.4.6|Jas 4:6]], [[r:1PE.5.5|1Pe 5:5]]" (LXX).† SYN.: ἀλαζών, ὑβριστής, see Tr., Syn., § xxix (AS)

G5290.strongs: to turn under (behind), i.e. to return (literally or figuratively)
G5290.kjv: come again, return (again, back again), turn back (again)
senses: ὑπο-στρέφω
trans., to turn back or about (Hem.).

G5293.kjv: be under obedience (obedient), put under, subdue unto, (be, make) subject (to, unto), be (put) in subjection (to, under), submit self unto
senses: ὑπο-τάσσω
as a military term, to place or rank under (Polyb.).

G5298.strongs: to vacate down, i.e. retire quietly
senses: ὑπο-χωρέω to go back, retire: before ἐν, [[r:LUK.5.16|Luk 5:16]]; before εἰς, [[r:LUK.9.10|Luk 9:10.]]† (AS)

poss. pron. of second of person(s) pl. (= emphasized genitive, ὑμῶν), your, yours: [[r:JHN.7.6|Jhn 7:6 8:17 15:20]], [[r:ACT.27.34|Act 27:34]], [[r:ROM.11.31|Rom 11:31]], [[r:1CO.16.17|1Co 16:17]], [[r:2CO.8.8|2Co 8:8]], [[r:GAL.6.13|Gal 6:13]]; as pred., [[r:LUK.6.20|Luk 6:20]]; τὸ ὑ., as subst., opposite to τ. ἀλλότριον, [[r:LUK.16.12|Luk 16:12]] (WH, txt., R, mg., ἡμέτερον); objectively, ὑ. καύχησις, my glorying in you, [[r:1CO.15.31|1Co 15:31.]]† (AS)

G5240.root: from [[w:G5228]] and the alternate form of [[w:G1632]]
G5240.strongs: to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow
senses: ὑπερ-εκ-χύννω (Rec. -ύνω), late form of -χέω to pour out over. Pass., to overflow, run over: [[r:LUK.6.38|Luk 6:38]] (not elsewhere).† (AS)

G5274.strongs: to take from below, i.e. carry upward; figuratively, to take up, i.e. continue a discourse or topic; mentally, to assume (presume)
senses: ὑπο-λαμβάνω
to take or bear up (by supporting from beneath): with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.1.9|Act 1:9.]]
to receive, welcome, entertain (Xen.): III Jn 8.
to catch up in speech (Hdt., al.; Jb, ll. with): [[r:LUK.10.30|Luk 10:30.]]
Of mental action, to assume, suppose (Xen., al.; To, Wis, 3Mac, ll. with): [[r:ACT.2.15|Act 2:15]]; before ὅτι (see Bl., § 70, 2), [[r:LUK.7.43|Luk 7:43.]]† (AS)
ὑπο-μονή, -ῆς, ἡ (ὑπομένω)
a remaining behind (Arist.).

G5264.strongs: to admit under one's roof, i.e. entertain hospitably
senses: ὑπο-δέχομαι to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.19.6|Luk 19:6]], [[r:ACT.17.7|Act 17:7]], [[r:JAS.2.25|Jas 2:25]]; εἰς τ. οἶκον, [[r:LUK.10.38|Luk 10:38]] (see MM, xxv).† (AS)

G5203.root: from a compound of [[w:G5204]] and a derivative of [[w:G3700]] (as if looking watery)
senses: (ὕδρωψ, dropsy), dropsical, suffering from dropsy: [[r:LUK.14.2|Luk 14:2.]]† (AS)

G5299.root: from a compound of [[w:G5259]] and a derivative of [[w:G3700]]
G5299.strongs: to hit under the eye (buffet or disable an antagonist as a pugilist), i.e. (figuratively) to tease or annoy (into compliance), subdue (one's passions)
senses: (ὑπώπιον, (a) the part of the face below the eyes; (b) a blow on the face), to strike under the eye, give a black eye: metaphorically,
of persistent annoyance (RV, wear out), [[r:LUK.18.6|Luk 18:6]];

of severe self-discipline (R, txt. buffet, mg. bruise), [[r:1CO.9.27|1Co 9:27]] (see Field, Notes, 71, 174).† ὑπο-πιάζω, later form of ὑποπιέζω, to press slightly; metaphorically, to repress: [[r:1CO.9.27|1Co 9:27]] T.7 for ὑπωπιάζω, which see† (AS)

G5291.strongs: to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet)
senses: ὑπο-στρωννύω late form of ὑπο-στορέννυμι, to spread or strew under: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.19.36|Luk 19:36.]]† (AS)

G5271.strongs: to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend)
senses: ὑπο-κρίνομαι
= Att.. ἀποκρίνομαι (which see), to answer, reply (Hom., Hdt., al.).
to answer on the stage, play apart (Arist., al.). Metaphorical, to feign, pretend (Demos., Polyb.): with accusative and inf., [[r:LUK.20.20|Luk 20:20]] (cf. [[r:PSS.4.22|Ps sol 4:22]]).† (AS)

G5279.strongs: to remind quietly, i.e. suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory
G5279.kjv: put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance
senses: ὑπο-μιμνήσκω to cause one to remember, put one in mind or remind one of: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:2TI.2.14|2Ti 2:14]], 3Jn 10; with dupl. accusative (Thus., al.), [[r:JHN.14.26|Jhn 14:26]]; with accusative of person(s), before περί, [[r:2PE.1.12|2Pe 1:12]]; id., before ὅτι, Ju 5; with inf., [[r:TIT.3.1|Tit 3:1]]; pass., with genitive of thing(s), [[r:LUK.22.61|Luk 22:61.]]† (AS)

G5200.strongs: wet (as if with rain), i.e. (by implication) sappy (fresh)
senses: [in LXX: [[r:JDG.16.7|Jdg 16:7]],8 (לַח), [[r:JOB.8.16|Job 8:16]] (רָשׂב), [[r:SIR.39.13|Sir 39:13]] wet, moist, opposite to ξηρός: of wood, sappy, green: [[r:LUK.23.31|Luk 23:31.]]† (AS)

G5201.strongs: a water-jar, i.e. receptacle for family supply
senses: (ὕδωρ),
prop., a water-pot or jar: [[r:JHN.2.6|Jhn 2:6]], 7 [[r:JHN.4.28|John 4:28]].
More frequently in Attic = ἄγγυς, a pot, urn or jar of any kind, as for holding wine, coins, etc. (see Rutherford, NPhr., 23; MM, xxv). † (AS)

G5262.strongs: an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively, specimen, adumbration)
senses: ὑπό-δειγμα, -τος, τό (ὑποδείκνυμι), used by later writers (Xen. onwards) for παράδειγμα (see Rutherford, NPhr., 62),
a figure, copy: [[r:HEB.8.5|Heb 8:5 9:23]];
an example: for imitation, [[r:JHN.13.15|Jhn 13:15]], [[r:JAS.5.10|Jas 5:10]]; for warning, [[r:HEB.4.11|Heb 4:11]], [[r:2PE.2.6|2Pe 2:6]].† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑποτύπωσις (see DB, iii. 696b) (AS)

G5253.strongs: a higher part of the house, i.e. apartment in the third story
senses: (neut. of ὑπερῷος, above, ὑπέρ)
in cl., the upper story or upper rooms where the women resided (Hom., a1.).
In LXX and NT, an upper chamber, roof-chamber, built on the flat roof of the house (see DB, iii, 674a): [[r:ACT.1.13|Act 1:13 9:37, 39 20:8]] (cf. [[r:2KI.23.22|4Ki.23:22]]).† (AS)

G5223.strongs: existency or proprietorship, i.e. (concretely) property, wealth
senses: (ὑπάρχω),
subsistence, existence (Arist., al.).
In late writers, = τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, substance, property: [[r:HEB.10.34|Heb 10:34]]; pl., [[r:ACT.2.45|Act 2:45.]]† (AS)

G5260.strongs: to throw in stealthily, i.e. introduce by collusion
senses: ὑπο-βάλλω to throw or put under. Metaphorical,
to subject, submit;
to suggest, whisper, prompt; (with) to suborn (see Field, Notes, 113), instigate: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.6.11|Act 6:11.]]† (AS)
(ὑπακσύω), giving ear, obedient, subject: [[r:PHP.2.8|Php 2:8]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.7.39|Act 7:39]]; εἰς πάντα, [[r:2CO.2.9|2Co 2:9.]]† (AS)

G5282.strongs: to think under (privately), i.e. to surmise or conjecture
senses: ὑπο νοέω, -ῶ to suspect, conjecture: [[r:ACT.25.18|Act 25:18]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.13.25|Act 13:25 27:27]].† (AS)

G5256.strongs: to be a subordinate, i.e. (by implication) subserve
senses: (ὑπηρέτης) prop., to serve as rower on a ship (Diod., al.). In cl. always metaphorically, to minister to, serve: with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.13.36|Act 13:36 20:34 24:23]].† (AS)
(ὕω, to rain), rain: [[r:ACT.14.17|Act 14:17 28:2]], [[r:HEB.6.7|Heb 6:7]], [[r:JAS.5.18|Jas 5:18]], [[r:REV.11.6|Rev 11:6]]; ὄψιμος (which see), sc. ὑ., [[r:JAS.5.7|Jas 5:7.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-εῖδον, aor. to overlook: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.17.30|Act 17:30]] (AS)

G5288.strongs: to withhold under (out of sight), i.e. (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve)
senses: ὑπο-στέλλω
to draw in, let down (ἱστίον, οὐράν, etc.).

to draw back, withdraw: ἑαυτόν, [[r:GAL.2.12|Gal 2:12]] (Polyb., al.; see Lft., in l). Mid., to shrink or draw back: [[r:HEB.10.38|Heb 10:38]] (LXX); before τοῦ, with inf., [[r:ACT.20.27|Act 20:27]]; οὐδέν, [[r:ACT.20.20|Act 20:20.]]† (AS)

G5284.strongs: to sail under the lee of
senses: ὑπο-πλέω to sail under, i.e. under the lee of: with accusative, [[r:ACT.27.4|Act 27:4]], 7.† (AS)
ὑπο-πνέω
to blow underneath (Arist.).
to blow gently: [[r:ACT.27.13|Act 27:13.]]† (AS)

G5295.strongs: to run under, i.e. (specially), to sail past
senses: ὑπο-τρέχω to run in under; of navigators, to run in the lee of: with accusative (see M, Pr., 65), [[r:ACT.27.16|Act 27:16.]]† (AS)

G5269.strongs: to gird under, i.e. frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck)
senses: ὑπο-ζώννυμι to undergird (Hdt., al.; ὑπὸ τ. μάστους, 2Mac, l.with); of a ship, to undergird or frap: [[r:ACT.27.17|Act 27:17]] (see DB, ext. 367a).† (AS)

G5218.strongs: attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission
senses: (ὑπακούω), obedience (opposite to παρακοή);

in general, absol., εἰς ὑ., [[r:ROM.6.16|Rom 6:16]]; with genitive subjc., [[r:2CO.7.15|2Co 7:15 10:6]], Phm 21; with genitive obj., [[r:ROM.1.5|Rom 1:5]] (Lft, Notes, 246) [[r:ROM.16.26|Rom 16:26]], [[r:1PE.1.22|1Pe 1:22]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[r:2CO.10.5|2Co 10:5.]]

Of obedience to God's commands: absol., [[r:1PE.1.2|1Pe 1:2]]; opposite to ἁμαρτία, [[r:ROM.6.16|Rom 6:16]]; τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, [[r:1PE.1.14|1Pe 1:14]]; with genitive subj., [[r:ROM.15.18|Rom 15:18 16:19]].
Of Christ's obedience: absol., [[r:HEB.5.8|Heb 5:8]]; with genitive subj., [[r:ROM.5.19|Rom 5:19.]] (The word is not found except in LXX, NT and eccl.).† (AS)
brought to trial, answerable to: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[r:ROM.3.19|Rom 3:19]] (see MM, xxv).† (AS)
ὑπερ-περισσεύω to abound more exceedingly: [[r:ROM.5.21|Rom 5:21.]] Mid., in same sense (RV, overflow): with dative of thing(s), [[r:2CO.7.4|2Co 7:4.]]† (AS)

G5220.strongs: in subjection under a man, i.e. a married woman
senses: under or subject to a man, married: γυνή, [[r:ROM.7.2|Rom 7:2]] (Polyb., Diod., al.).† (AS)

G5236.strongs: a throwing beyond others, i.e. (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with or) pre- eminently
G5236.kjv: abundance, (far more) exceeding, excellency, more excellent, beyond (out of) measure
senses: ὑπερ-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ὑπερβάλλω), a throwing beyond. Metaphorical, excess, superiority, excellence: [[r:2CO.4.7|2Co 4:7 12:7]]; καθ᾽ ὑπερβολήν, beyond measure, exceedingly, [[r:ROM.7.13|Rom 7:13]], [[r:1CO.12.31|1Co 12:31]], [[r:2CO.1.8|2Co 1:8]], [[r:GAL.1.13|Gal 1:13]]; κ. ὑ. εἰς ὑ., beyond all measure, [[r:2CO.4.17|2Co 4:17.]]† (AS)

G5206.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G5207]] and a derivative of [[w:G5087]]
G5206.strongs: the placing as a son, i.e. adoption (figuratively, Christian sonship in respect to God)
senses: (cf. the cl. phrases, υἱὸν τίθεσθαι, θετὸς υἱός), frequently in Inscr. (see Deiss., BS, 239), adoption of a son (or daughter); metaphorically, of God's relation established
with Israel: [[r:ROM.9.4|Rom 9:4]];
with Christ­ians: [[r:ROM.8.15|Rom 8:15]], [[r:GAL.4.5|Gal 4:5]], [[r:EPH.1.5|Eph 1:5]]; of its consummation, [[r:ROM.8.23|Rom 8:23.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-εν-τυγχάνω to intercede or make petition for (see Deiss., BS, 121 f.): before ὑπέρ, [[r:ROM.8.26|Rom 8:26.]]† (AS)

G5245.strongs: to vanquish beyond, i.e. gain a decisive victory
senses: ὑπερ-νικάω, -ῶ to be more than conqueror: [[r:ROM.8.37|Rom 8:37]] (eccl.).† (AS)

G5275.strongs: to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive)
senses: ὑπο-λείπω to leave remaining (Hom., Thuc., al.): pass., of survivors, [[r:ROM.11.3|Rom 11:3.]]† (AS)

G5252.strongs: to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e. be vain or arrogant
senses: ὑπερ-φρονέω, -ῶ
to be overproud, high-minded (Æsch.): μὴ ὑ. παρ᾽ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν (on the paranom., see Vau., in l), [[r:ROM.12.3|Rom 12:3.]]
to overlook, think slightly of (Thuc., Plat.).† (AS)

G5242.strongs: to hold oneself above, i.e. (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority
senses: ὑπερ-έχω
trans., to hold over or above.
Intrans. (when a noun follows, the case is governed by the prep.; see Bl., § 34, 1; 36, 8), to rise above, overtop; metaphorically,
to be superior in rank, etc.: [[r:ROM.13.1|Rom 13:1]], [[r:1PE.2.13|1Pe 2:13]] (cf. [[r:WIS.6.6|Wis 6:6]]);

to be superior, excel, surpass: with genitive (cl.; see supr.), [[r:PHP.2.3|Php 2:3]]; with accusative (cl.; see supr.), [[r:PHP.4.7|Php 4:7]]; as subst., τ. ὑπερέχον, the excel­lency, the surpassing worth, [[r:PHP.3.8|Php 3:8.]]† (AS)

G5294.strongs: to place underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to hazard, (reflexively) to suggest
senses: ὑπο-τίθημι to place under, lay down. Metaphorical, τ. τράχηλον ὑποθεῖναι, to risk one's life (see Deiss., LAE, 119 f.): [[r:ROM.16.4|Rom 16:4]]; mid., to suggest: [[r:1TI.4.6|1Ti 4:6.]]† (AS)

G5247.strongs: prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character)
senses: (ὑπερέχω) a projection, eminence, as the peak of a mountain. Metaphorical (Arist.), excellence, pre-eminence: λόγου ἢ σοφίας, [[r:1CO.2.1|1Co 2:1]]; οἱ ἐν ὑ (for a parallel to this phrase, see Deiss., BS, 255, and cf. 2Mac, l.with), [[r:1TI.2.2|1Ti 2:2.]]† (AS)

G5230.strongs: beyond the "acme", i.e. figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth
senses: past the bloom of youth: [[r:1CO.7.36|1Co 7:36]] (Eustath.).† (AS)

G5297.strongs: to bear from underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to undergo hardship
senses: ὑπο-φέρω to bear by being under. Metaphorical, to endure: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.10.13|1Co 10:13]], [[r:2TI.3.11|2Ti 3:11]], [[r:1PE.2.19|1Pe 2:19]].† (AS)

G5235.strongs: to throw beyod the usual mark, i.e. (figuratively) to surpass (only active participle supereminent)
senses: ὑπερ-βάλλω
trans., to throw over or beyond.
Intrans., to run beyond. In both senses, metaphorically, to exceed, surpass, transcend: [[r:2CO.3.10|2Co 3:10 9:14]], [[r:EPH.1.19|Eph 1:19 2:7]]; with genitive obj., [[r:EPH.3.19|Eph 3:19.]]† (AS)

G5287.strongs: a setting under (support), i.e. (figuratively) concretely, essence, or abstractly, assurance (objectively or subjectively)
senses: ὑπό-στασις, -εως, ἡ (ὑφίστημι, to set under, stand under, support)
a support, base or foundation (in various senses).
substance (Arist., al.; opposite to φαντασία, ἔμφασις): [[r:HEB.1.3|Heb 1:3]]

steadiness, firmness (Polyb., al.), hence, assurance, confidence: [[r:2CO.9.4|2Co 9:4 11:17]], [[r:HEB.3.14|Heb 3:14 11:1]] (here perhaps title-deed, as that which gives reality or guarantee; see MM, xxv).† (AS)
ὑπερ-εκ-τείνω to stretch out overmuch: metaphorically, ἑαυτούς, [[r:2CO.10.14|2Co 10:14.]]† (AS)

G5238.root: from [[w:G5228]] and the neuter plural of [[w:G1565]]
G5238.strongs: above those parts, i.e. still farther
senses: ὑπερ-έκεινα comp. adv. (see Bl., 28, 2; M, Pr., 99), beyond: as prep. with genitive, τὰ ὑ. ὑμῶν, [[r:2CO.10.16|2Co 10:16]] (Byz. and [[r:ECC.1.1|Ecc 1:1-18.]]).† (AS)

G5234.root: adverb from present participle active of [[w:G5235]]
senses: ὑπερβαλλόντως above measure: [[r:2CO.11.23|2Co 11:23.]]† (AS)

G5229.strongs: to raise oneself over, i.e. (figuratively) to become haughty
G5229.kjv: exalt self, be exalted above measure
senses: ὑπερ-αίρω to lift or raise over. Mid., to uplift oneself: [[r:2CO.12.7|2Co 12:7]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, of person(s), [[r:2TH.2.4|2Th 2:4]] (cf. [[r:2MA.5.23|2Ma 5:23]]).† (AS)

G5231.strongs: above upward, i.e. greatly higher (in place or rank)
senses: ὑπερ-άνω compound adv., above: as prep. with genitive, [[r:EPH.1.21|Eph 1:21 4:10]], [[r:HEB.9.5|Heb 9:5]].† (AS)

G5215.root: apparently from a simpler (obsolete) form of ὑδέω (to celebrate
G5215.strongs: probably akin to; compare); a "hymn" or religious ode (one of the Psalms)
senses: a hymn;
in cl. a festal song in praise of gods or heroes;

in LXX and NT a song of praise addressed to God: [[r:EPH.5.19|Eph 5:19]], [[r:COL.3.16|Col 3:16]].† SYN.: ψαλμός, that which is sung to a musical accompaniment; ᾠδή, the generic term for song (cf. Tr., Syn., § LXXviii, Lft. on [[r:COL.3.16|Col 3:16]]) (AS)

G5251.strongs: to elevate above others, i.e. raise to the highest position
senses: ὑπερ-υψόω, -ῶ
to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place: [[r:PHP.2.9|Php 2:9.]]
to extol (Da, ll. with).† (AS)

G5227.strongs: under (covertly) contrary to, i.e. opposed or (as noun) an opponent
senses: ὑπ-εναντίος, -α, -ον set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), opposed to, contrary to: with dative of person(s), [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14]]; absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., [[r:HEB.10.27|Heb 10:27]] (cf. [[r:ISA.26.11|Isa 26:11]]).† (AS)
ὑπερ-βαίνω
trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, overreach: [[r:1TH.4.6|1Th 4:6]]).
Intrans., to transgress: metaphorically, [[r:1TH.4.6|1Th 4:6]] (R, txt.; see M, Th., in l).† (AS)
ὑπερ-αυξάνω to increase beyond measure: [[r:2TH.1.3|2Th 1:3]] (see Lft., Notes, 98).† (AS)
ὑπερ-πλεονάζω to abound exceedingly: [[r:1TI.1.14|1Ti 1:14]] ([[r:PSS.5.19|Ps Sol 5:19]]; Herm., Mand., v, 2, 5).† (AS)

G5296.root: from a compound of [[w:G5259]] and a derivative of [[w:G5179]]
G5296.strongs: typification under (after), i.e. (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation
senses: ὑπο-τύπωσις, -εως, ἡ (ὑποτυπόω, to delineate), an outline, sketch. Metaphorical, a pattern, example: [[r:1TI.1.16|1Ti 1:16]], [[r:2TI.1.13|2Ti 1:13]].† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑπόδειγμα (see DB, iii, 696b) (AS)

G5202.root: from a compound of [[w:G5204]] and a derivative of [[w:G4095]]
G5202.strongs: to be a water-drinker, i.e. to abstain from vinous beverages
senses: ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ (ὕδωρ, πίνω), to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: [[r:1TI.5.23|1Ti 5:23]] (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).† (AS)
(ὑπονοέω), a suspicion: [[r:1TI.6.4|1Ti 6:4.]]† (AS)
ὑπόμινησις, -εως, ἡ (ὑπομιμνήσκω) a reminding, reminder: ἐν ὑ., [[r:2PE.1.13|2Pe 1:13 3:1]]; with genitive, [[r:2TI.1.5|2Ti 1:5.]]† (AS)
ὑπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ὑποστέλλω),
a letting down, lowering (Plut.).
a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), [[r:HEB.10.39|Heb 10:39.]]† (AS)
ὑπ-είκω
to retire, withdraw.
to yield, submit: metaphorically, [[r:HEB.13.17|Heb 13:17.]]† (AS)
wood, forest, woodland (Thus., Xen., al.).
wood, timber, fuel (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[r:JAS.3.5|Jas 3:5]] (see Hort, Ja., 70, 104 f.).
= Lat. materia, esp. in Philosophy, matter (Arist. and later writers; Wis, ll. with).† (AS)
ὑπο-λιμτάνω collat. form of ὑπολείπω, to leave behind: [[r:1PE.2.21|1Pe 2:21.]]† (AS)

G5261.strongs: an underwriting, i.e. copy for imitation (figuratively)
senses: (ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying),
a writing-copy, hence,
an example: [[r:1PE.2.11|1Pe 2:11]] (Philo).† (AS)
ὑπέρ-ογκος, -ον of excessive weight or size; metaphorically, excessive, immoderate, in late writers, of arrogant speech (see Mayor on Ju, l.with): n. pl., [[r:2PE.2.18|2Pe 2:18]], Ju 16.† (AS)

G5254.strongs: to hold oneself under, i.e. endure with patience
senses: ὑπ-έχω to hold or put under. Metaphorical, to undergo, suffer: δίκην, Ju 7 (Soph., Eur., al.).† (AS)
